description.en: Follow a sunrise in Hangzhou, trace the seasons and watch two worlds cast shadows. Six narrated experiments connect the view from space with the sky from Earth.
description.zh: 从杭州的日出到月影划过地球，用六个有声实验连接太空与地面视角。

question.en: Why does the Sun rise each day in Hangzhou?
question.zh: 站在杭州，为什么每天都能看到日出？

aliases: Why do we have day and night?

question.en: Why do the two hemispheres have different day lengths in June?
question.zh: 六月同一天，为什么南北两地的白昼长短不同？

question.en: Why are there special lines at 23.4° north and south?
question.zh: 地球仪为什么要在南北纬 23.4° 各画一条线？

question.en: If the Moon spins, why do we see nearly the same face?
question.zh: 月球明明在转，为什么地球上总看到大致相同的一面？

aliases: 为什么月球总是一面对着地球
Why do we see the same side of the Moon?

title.en: Moon phases and the lunar month

question.en: Why does the same Moon change from a thin crescent to a full disk?
question.zh: 总是同一个月球，为什么一会儿像弯钩，一会儿又像圆盘？

aliases: Why does the Moon change shape?

question.en: Why don’t eclipses happen at every new or full Moon?
question.zh: 新月和满月每月都有，为什么日食和月食不每月都发生？

aliases: 为什么不是每个月都有日食和月食
